title: App and Server
description: Study the implementation in [public/app.js] and [src/server.js]. Trace its declarations and dependencies into a caller or test. Prominent declared symbols visible in the inspected excerpt include toBase64, fromBase64, deriveKey, encrypt, decrypt, log, connect, send, createChatServer; confirm their complete definitions and callers in the file.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in public/app.js, src/server.js.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
